scope: Read-only integrity audit of the repository catalogue and image files immediately before release 9 was committed. This report records the completed checks without repeating them.
limitations: Checks were performed on the final repository working tree before commit 281355b; the commit identifier associates this report with release 9 and does not indicate that the audit was rerun after committing.
The audit verifies references, metadata, file hashes and recorded review provenance. It does not repeat the visual QA of machine geometry, branding, colours, mechanisms or text.
Image metadata was inspected with sharp; this report does not claim a fresh full pixel decode or visual inspection of every file.
Deployment and live publication of release 9 were not checked by this audit. No live publication status is changed by this report.
Image integrity does not certify product specifications, available configurations, legal data, privacy approval, SMTP delivery, Turnstile setup or Search Console activation.
